APPROVE
The pin-containment loop, base-at-pin caching and bench stage move into helpers with the same conditions, messages, call order and cache writes, so `CheckAsync`'s complexity should land at or below 15 with no change in behaviour and no nullability errors. I couldn't see the elided middle of the method, so I'm assuming `index` is a field or constructor parameter, nothing after the split uses `only`, and `Short` doesn't clash with an existing member.
